points.place: 斯塔夫罗波尔边疆区普里沃利诺耶村
points.title: 童年与教育
points.description: 戈尔巴乔夫1931年3月2日出生于斯塔夫罗波尔边疆区的一个农民家庭。他的童年正值斯大林时期，经历了集体化和大饥荒的艰难岁月。1946年，他开始在斯塔夫罗波尔农学院学习，并在1950年以优异成绩毕业。这段农村经历塑造了他对农业问题的关注，也培养了他对集体主义的初步认识。他在大学期间加入苏联共产党，开始了他的政治生涯。
points.descriptionEn: Mikhail Gorbachev was born on March 2, 1931, in the village of Privolnoye in the Stavropol Krai to a peasant family. His childhood coincided with Stalin's era, experiencing the hardships of collectivization and the famine of 1932-33. In 1946, he began studying at the Stavropol Agricultural Institute, graduating with honors in 1950. This rural upbringing shaped his focus on agricultural issues and fostered his early understanding of collectivism. He joined the Communist Party of the Soviet Union during his university years, beginning his political career.

points.title: 地方政治生涯
points.description: 从莫斯科国立大学法律系毕业后，戈尔巴乔夫返回斯塔夫罗波尔，开始了他的地方政治生涯。他先后担任共青团斯塔夫罗波尔边疆区委员会第一书记、边疆区农业部门负责人等职务。在此期间，他推动了当地的农业改革，尝试提高农业生产效率。1970年，他被任命为斯塔夫罗波尔边疆区党委第一书记，成为地方最高领导人。这段经历使他积累了丰富的行政管理经验，也让他看到了苏联体制的弊端，特别是农业领域的低效问题。
points.descriptionEn: After graduating from Moscow State University's Law Faculty, Gorbachev returned to Stavropol, beginning his regional political career. He successively held positions such as First Secretary of the Komsomol (Young Communist League) of the Stavropol Krai Committee and head of the agricultural department. During this period, he promoted local agricultural reforms, attempting to improve production efficiency. In 1970, he was appointed First Secretary of the Stavropol Krai Party Committee, becoming the region's top leader. This experience provided him with extensive administrative skills and exposed him to the flaws of the Soviet system, particularly in the agricultural sector.

points.title: 中央政治崛起
points.description: 1978年，戈尔巴乔夫调任莫斯科，担任苏共中央委员会农业部长。1980年，他成为苏共中央政治局最年轻的成员，标志着他进入苏联最高领导层。在此期间，他深入研究了苏联的经济问题，特别是农业领域的困境。他多次出国访问，包括西方国家，这些经历开阔了他的国际视野，使他认识到苏联与西方的差距。1983-1984年，他领导了苏联的农业改革尝试，但效果有限。这段时期，他开始形成自己的政治理念，包括对改革和开放的初步构想。
points.descriptionEn: In 1978, Gorbachev was transferred to Moscow, becoming Head of the Agriculture Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party. In 1980, he became the youngest member of the Politburo, marking his entry into the Soviet leadership's inner circle. During this period, he deeply studied the Soviet Union's economic problems, particularly the difficulties in agriculture. He made numerous foreign visits, including to Western countries, which broadened his international perspective and made him aware of the gap between the Soviet Union and the West. From 1983-1984, he led agricultural reform attempts with limited success. During this time, he began to form his own political ideas, including preliminary concepts of reform and openness.

points.title: 苏联领导人
points.description: 1985年3月，戈尔巴乔夫当选苏共中央总书记，成为苏联最高领导人。他提出了改革（Perestroika）和新思维（Glasnost）政策，试图在不改变社会主义制度的前提下改革苏联经济和政治体制。他推动了一系列重大改革，包括放松经济管制、鼓励私有企业发展、扩大政治自由等。在国际关系方面，他结束了冷战，与美国总统里根、布什签署了多项裁军协议，从阿富汗撤军，改善了与西方国家的关系。然而，他的改革也导致了苏联各加盟共和国的民族主义抬头和经济混乱，最终加速了苏联的解体过程。
points.descriptionEn: In March 1985, Gorbachev was elected General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, becoming the country's top leader. He introduced policies of Perestroika (restructuring) and Glasnost (openness), attempting to reform the Soviet economic and political systems without changing the socialist system. He pushed for major reforms including economic deregulation, encouragement of private enterprise, and expansion of political freedoms. In international relations, he ended the Cold War, signed several disarmament agreements with US Presidents Reagan and Bush, withdrew troops from Afghanistan, and improved relations with Western countries. However, his reforms also led to the rise of nationalism in Soviet republics and economic chaos, ultimately accelerating the dissolution of the Soviet Union.

points.title: 苏联解体
points.description: 1991年8月，苏联发生了旨在推翻戈尔巴乔夫的政变（八一九事件）。政变失败后，戈尔巴乔夫的权力被大幅削弱，各加盟共和国纷纷宣布独立。同年12月25日，戈尔巴乔夫宣布辞去苏联总统职务，苏联正式解体。他试图通过保留某种形式的联盟来维持国家统一，但未能成功。辞职后，他成为'苏联总统'的象征性职位，直到1992年初完全退出政治舞台。这一时期标志着他政治生涯的终结，也象征着冷战时代的结束。
points.descriptionEn: In August 1991, the August Coup occurred, an attempt to overthrow Gorbachev. After the coup failed, Gorbachev's power was significantly weakened, and Soviet republics began declaring independence one after another. On December 25, 1991, Gorbachev resigned as President of the Soviet Union, formally dissolving the USSR. He had attempted to maintain national unity through some form of federation but failed. After his resignation, he remained in a symbolic presidential role until early 1992 when he completely withdrew from politics. This period marked the end of his political career and symbolized the end of the Cold War era.

points.title: 退休后活动
points.description: 离开政治舞台后，戈尔巴乔夫创立了戈尔巴乔夫基金会，致力于研究民主转型和国际问题。他积极参与国际事务，担任多个国际组织的顾问，并获得了诺贝尔和平奖（1990年）。他批评俄罗斯国内政治的发展方向，特别是普京集权政策，并继续倡导民主和改革。尽管健康状况不佳，他仍保持活跃，发表演讲和接受采访。晚年，他对苏联解体持复杂态度，既承认改革的必要性，也对解体过程感到遗憾。他被视为20世纪末最重要的政治转型人物之一，其历史评价仍然存在争议。
points.descriptionEn: After leaving politics, Gorbachev founded the Gorbachev Foundation, dedicated to researching democratic transitions and international issues. He actively participated in international affairs, serving as an advisor to various international organizations and receiving the Nobel Peace Prize (1990). He criticized the direction of Russian domestic politics, particularly Putin's authoritarian policies, and continued to advocate for democracy and reform. Despite declining health, he remained active, giving speeches and granting interviews. In his later years, he held a complex view of the Soviet Union's dissolution, acknowledging the necessity of reforms while expressing regret about the process. He is regarded as one of the most significant figures of late 20th-century political transformation, with his historical evaluation remaining controversial.

supporter.zh: 戈尔巴乔夫被支持者视为和平结束冷战的英雄和民主改革的先驱。他勇敢地面对苏联体制的深层问题，通过改革和新思维政策，为苏联社会带来了前所未有的开放和自由。他促成了德国统一，结束了军备竞赛，避免了可能的核战争，为世界和平做出了重大贡献。他的改革虽然导致了苏联解体，但也为俄罗斯和其他前苏联国家向民主制度转型创造了条件，是历史进步的推动者。
supporter.en: Supporters view Gorbachev as a hero who peacefully ended the Cold War and a pioneer of democratic reform. He courageously confronted deep-seated problems in the Soviet system, bringing unprecedented openness and freedom to Soviet society through Perestroika and Glasnost. He facilitated German reunification, ended the arms race, and potentially prevented nuclear war, making significant contributions to world peace. Although his reforms led to the Soviet Union's dissolution, they created conditions for Russia and other former Soviet states to transition toward democracy, making him a driver of historical progress.

critic.zh: 批评者认为戈尔巴乔夫的改革过于激进且缺乏规划，导致社会混乱和经济崩溃。他被指责软弱无力，未能维护苏联的统一和稳定，使国家陷入贫困和动荡。批评者认为他天真地相信西方承诺，忽视了国家利益，导致俄罗斯国际地位大幅下降。此外，他被批评为'叛徒'，认为他背叛了社会主义理想，导致苏联解体和俄罗斯数十年的衰落，使国家失去了超级大国地位。
critic.en: Critics argue that Gorbachev's reforms were too radical and poorly planned, leading to social chaos and economic collapse. They accuse him of weakness and inability to maintain the Soviet Union's unity and stability, plunging the country into poverty and turmoil. Critics believe he naively trusted Western promises while neglecting national interests, causing Russia's international status to decline significantly. Additionally, he is denounced as a 'traitor' for betraying socialist ideals, leading to the Soviet Union's dissolution and Russia's decades-long decline, causing the country to lose its superpower status.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，戈尔巴乔夫被视为一个复杂且矛盾的历史人物。他既是冷战结束的关键推动者，也是苏联解体的直接责任人。他的改革既有解放思想的积极一面，也有导致国家分裂的消极后果。历史学者普遍认为，他试图在维持社会主义框架下进行改革，但低估了改革的复杂性和风险。在流行文化中，他常被描绘为一位有远见但缺乏决心的领导人，其形象从早期的改革英雄逐渐转变为一个悲剧性人物，反映了历史转型的复杂性和个人在历史洪流中的局限性。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Gorbachev is viewed as a complex and contradictory historical figure. He was both a key driver of the Cold War's end and directly responsible for the Soviet Union's dissolution. His reforms had both positive aspects in liberating thought and negative consequences leading to national fragmentation. Historians generally agree that he attempted to implement reforms within a socialist framework but underestimated their complexity and risks. In popular culture, he is often portrayed as a visionary but indecisive leader, his image evolving from an early reform hero to a tragic figure, reflecting the complexities of historical transformation and the limitations of individuals within historical currents.

self.zh: 如果我们不改变，一切都将失去。
self.en: If we do not change, everything will be lost.

others.zh: 戈尔巴乔夫是一位伟大的改革者，他结束了冷战，但没有能够拯救苏联。
others.en: Gorbachev was a great reformer who ended the Cold War but was not able to save the Soviet Union.
